parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables or Disables Hotspot 2.0 indication on the access point.

parameters.name: Version
parameters.description: Passpoint specification version as described in {{bibref|Passpoint|Table 5. Passpoint Specification version number definition}}.

parameters.name: OperatorFriendlyName
parameters.description: Indicates that operator's preferred friendly name used for Online Sign Up purposes to the Passpoint hotspot operator for advertisement as described in {{bibref|Passpoint|Section 4.3}}.

parameters.name: DGAFDisable
parameters.description: Indicates the state of the Downstream group-addressed forwarding Disable bit in the HS2.0 Indication element as described in {{bibref|Passpoint|Section 5.2}}.

object.description: This object describes Passpoint/HotSpot 2.0 elements as defined in {{bibref|Passpoint}}.
